title: Seven Commander staples as a manual Oracle batch

provenance.oracleText: All raw fields and catalog metadata match the SHA-256-verified pinned Scryfall oracle_cards snapshot exactly, including reminder text.
provenance.requiredVerification: Completed by scripts/sync-commander-staples-source.mjs; rerun without --write to verify the pinned snapshot and runtime/report parity.
provenance.oracleIds: Verified by unique Oracle ID in the pinned snapshot.
provenance.scryfallIds: All seven print IDs come from the pinned snapshot; runtime images use those exact print IDs.

implementationNotes: Smothering Tithe and Esper Sentinel ask the paying opponent. A human or remote player always gets both choices; a local AI pays only when the tax is at most the value denied ({2} for a Treasure, {3} for a card) and, while developing on its own turn, still leaves two mana.
Esper Sentinel reads X on resolution and uses the creature's last known power if it has left the battlefield.

Orcish Bowmasters ignores only the first card an opponent draws during that opponent's own draw step. Amass Orcs 1 creates a 0/0 black Orc Army token when needed. If the single target becomes illegal, the whole ability does nothing.

Necropotence exiles the card face down with no one allowed to look at it and returns it at its controller's next end step. Paying exactly the remaining life total is legal; ordinary state-based actions still apply.

Underworld Breach uses the engine's escape path and exiles three other cards after mana payment. Split halves (including aftermath), Room doors, Adventure spells and nonland modal faces use the chosen spell's printed mana cost. Land faces, transforming backs, fuse outside the hand and cards with no payable mana cost remain unavailable.

Mana Drain's mana arrives at the beginning of the caster's next main phase, including the postcombat main phase of the same turn, as colorless mana. An uncounterable target is still legal, so the mana is still added; a target that has left the Stack makes Mana Drain do nothing.

Urza's mana ability may tap any untapped artifact, including summoning-sick artifact creatures. The Construct uses the existing BRC Construct token art; the {5} permission lasts until end of turn and also allows a land play.

source.bulkDescription: A JSON file containing one Scryfall card object for each Oracle ID on Scryfall. The chosen sets for the cards are an attempt to return the most up-to-date recognizable version of the card.

selectionPolicy.names: Seven popular Commander staples that were absent from the runtime and listed in docs/catalog/remaining-cards.csv.
selectionPolicy.note: Every entry requires an explicit implementation in scripts-commander-staples.js and human/AI interaction tests in tests/commander-staples.test.mjs.
